answer_2.quote: Following prior work, we also evaluate the semantic similarity between the adversarial example and the original input using the cosine similarity of Universal Sentence Encoders (USE).

answer_4.quote: We show annotators on Amazon Mechanical Turk two snippets of text—one is not modified, and the other one is adversarially corrupted—and the annotator has to select which one is corrupted in less than 10 seconds.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators must choose which text snippet is corrupted (adversarially modified) within a 10-second time limit.
